description: Thatta Cement Company Limited was incorporated in 1980 as a public limited company and was a wholly owned subsidiary of the State Cement Corporation of Pakistan (Pvt.) Limited until the Government of Pakistan divested its shareholding in 2004. Its plant, based on dry-process technology, is located 115 km north-east of Karachi at Ghulamullah Road, Makli, District Thatta, where clinker capacity was expanded by 50% to 1,500 tons per day in 2005. The company obtained listing on the Karachi Stock Exchange, now the Pakistan Stock Exchange, in 2008.
headOffice: CL/5-4, State Life Building #10, Abdullah Haroon Road, Karachi, Pakistan

products.name: Sulphate Resistant Cement
products.summary: Thatta Sulphate Resistant Cement, for areas affected by salinity, coastal belts, piling work and dams, with high early strength and low heat of hydration.

products.name: Portland Blast Furnace Slag Cement
products.summary: Thatta Slag Cement, for structures in hostile soils with high salinity, as well as dams, bridges and earth-retaining structures.

products.name: Ground Granulated Blast Furnace Slag
products.summary: GGBF slag ground to a fineness of around 4,000 Blaine, for blending with cement and as a filler in foundations.
